conduct summary glitch
11 Jan, 2023 @ 8:36pm
oli
I think my conduct summary glitched or something. Hear me out...

I was at 10K (always been at 10K) then I get 1 abandon (had to leave for personal reasons), next thing I know I go from 10K behavior to 166...


That being said, I decided to speedrun the next 15 matches in 2 days to get out of there, thinking that I would go back to 10K after the next conduct summary... But no, It only went up to 936 (despite having a bunch a commends, no abandons and no reports).

Now i'm screwed because these last 15 games at this behavioral score were a torture, it was literally unplayable, I had never experienced such a level of toxicity in over 10 years of dota (I have never went below 10K).
